vBRIEFInfo.description: Remove real subprocess/network dependence from mocked unit tests that flake with 5s vitest timeouts (main-branches, framework-commands, intake-coverage-boost) by stubbing/injecting the subprocess seams (#2166).

plan.title: test: remove real subprocess/network calls from mocked unit tests (flaky 5s timeouts)

narratives.Description: packages/core/src/doctor/main-branches.test.ts ("payload staleness skip branches") intermittently fails with a 5s vitest timeout because its default runGitLsRemote seam can perform a real network `git ls-remote`. Sibling tests (framework-commands, intake-coverage-boost, and the cmdCoreValidate / validateGithubAuthForWorker execFileSync tests folded in from #644/#2157 observations) share the same class of bug: a fully-mocked unit test depending on a real subprocess/network call. Fix by stubbing/injecting the seam, not by raising the timeout.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In main-branches.test.ts (and siblings sharing the seam), stub/inject runGitLsRemote so NO real network call is possible; optionally assert the seam is called with expected args. 2. Apply the same safe-injection pattern to the other flaky sites: framework-commands, intake-coverage-boost, and the execFileSync-backed cmdCoreValidate / validateGithubAuthForWorker tests. 3. Do NOT merely raise timeouts — remove the network/subprocess dependency. Follow the safe-injection pattern already used elsewhere in the doctor tests. 4. Confirm deterministic under a constrained/offline runner, well under the timeout. Test-only; no production behavior change. Run task check GREEN; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry (test hardening).
narratives.UserStory: As a contributor, I want mocked unit tests to never depend on real subprocess/network latency, so CI doesn't spuriously fail with 5s timeouts on unrelated PRs.

items.title: git-ls-remote seam stubbed in main-branches + siblings

narrative.Acceptance: The "payload staleness skip branches" test and siblings using the seam make no real network call; the seam is stubbed/injected.
framework-commands, intake-coverage-boost, cmdCoreValidate, validateGithubAuthForWorker tests inject/stub the subprocess seam; no real subprocess spawned.
Tests are deterministic under a constrained/offline runner and well under the timeout; task check passes; CHANGELOG entry added; no production change.
